entities.name: T3423 value
entities.description: This information element may be included to indicate a value for timer T3423. If this IE is not included, the UE shall use the default value.

entities.name: T3423
entities.description: Timer T3423 is configured by the network with a value provided in the T3423 value IE, or uses a default value if the IE is not included.

entities.name: T3423 value IE present
entities.description: Condition indicating whether the T3423 value information element is included in the message.

entities.name: Use default T3423 value
entities.description: Property indicating that the UE shall use the default value for timer T3423 when the T3423 value IE is not included.

relations.description: The T3423 value IE provides the timer value for T3423 when present.
The condition of IE presence determines whether the T3423 value IE is included.
When the T3423 value IE is not present, the condition establishes that the UE shall use the default timer value.
